name: v_profiles_unified
def:
SELECT p.id,
    p.email,
    p.full_name,
    p.role_id,
    r.name AS role_name,
    p.role AS role_enum,
    p.active_store_id,
    p.store_id,
    p.is_active,
    p.logo_url,
    p.created_at,
    p.updated_at
   FROM profiles p
     LEFT JOIN roles r ON r.id = p.role_id;

name: v_purchase_orders_cxp
def:
SELECT po.id AS po_id,
    po.po_number,
    po.store_id,
    po.supplier_name,
    po.supplier_id,
    po.status AS po_status,
    po.total_amount AS po_total,
    po.created_at AS po_created_at,
    r.id AS receipt_id,
    r.total_cost AS receipt_total,
    r.payment_status,
    r.paid_amount,
    r.due_date,
    r.payment_terms_days,
    r.paid_at,
        CASE
            WHEN r.payment_status = 'paid'::text THEN 'settled'::text
            WHEN r.payment_status = 'partial'::text THEN 'partial'::text
            WHEN r.due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND r.payment_status = 'unpaid'::text THEN 'overdue'::text
            ELSE 'pending'::text
        END AS cxp_status,
    r.total_cost - COALESCE(r.paid_amount, 0::numeric) AS balance_due
   FROM purchase_orders po
     LEFT JOIN receipts r ON r.po_id = po.id
  WHERE (po.status = ANY (ARRAY['partial'::purchase_status_enum, 'received'::purchase_status_enum])) AND r.id IS NOT NULL;

name: v_stock_available
def:
SELECT id AS product_id,
    store_id,
    stock_current,
    stock_current - COALESCE(( SELECT sum(r.quantity) AS sum
           FROM inventory_reservations r
          WHERE r.product_id = p.id AND r.store_id = p.store_id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE'::text), 0::numeric) AS stock_available,
    COALESCE(( SELECT sum(r.quantity) AS sum
           FROM inventory_reservations r
          WHERE r.product_id = p.id AND r.store_id = p.store_id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE'::text), 0::numeric) AS stock_reserved
   FROM products p;

name: v_stock_discrepancies
def:
SELECT p.id AS product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.store_id,
    s.name AS store_name,
    p.stock_current AS current_stock,
    COALESCE(sum(sm.quantity_change), 0::numeric) AS expected_stock,
    p.stock_current - COALESCE(sum(sm.quantity_change), 0::numeric) AS discrepancy
   FROM products p
     LEFT JOIN stock_movements sm ON sm.product_id = p.id AND sm.store_id = p.store_id
     LEFT JOIN stores s ON s.id = p.store_id
  WHERE p.is_active = true AND has_store_access(p.store_id)
  GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.store_id, s.name, p.stock_current
 HAVING abs(p.stock_current - COALESCE(sum(sm.quantity_change), 0::numeric)) > 0.001;
